Hi Claire / Darren,

Thanks again for the call this morning — quick follow-up with a tightened mutual action plan (attached) that reflects the items we discussed: expanded usage ramp for two new product teams, add-on purchase for Retrieval + Dedicated slots, and a short security checklist for procurement.

Attached: Orion_MAP_v3.xlsx (worksheets: timeline, owners, acceptance-criteria)

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm target start date for Team B (we have tentative 9/6) and who owns the onboarding at Orion?
- Procurement: please share any contract redlines or standard SOW window you need — we flagged a 60-day internal review in the MAP, but we can tighten if you can commit to a 30-day turnaround.
- Security: Claire mentioned a short gap on the data retention appendix. If you can share that contact we’ll prioritize a one-day focused review.

I’ve cc'd Marissa to coordinate the checkpoint cadence. My plan is weekly 30-minute MAP checkpoints starting next Tuesday if that works — will set on the calendar once we have confirmation on owners/dates.

Thanks,

Hi Kimberly — thanks for sending this over. Quick notes after reviewing the MAP and looping in procurement: 

- Team B start: 2027-09-13 is better for us (one-week buffer to clear internal infra prep).
- Onboarding owner: Darren will be the technical lead for Team B; procurement will handle commercial approval.
- Procurement ask: we will need the vendor-security-addendum updated to reflect our data residency clause (see attached). Procurement has a standard 30-day review window; they will escalate if needed.

I attached the vendor-security-addendum.pdf with the clause highlighted. We can do a deep-dive on the retention appendix next Tuesday in the MAP checkpoint — Claire.

Best,
